industry.headline: Meta, Google and TikTok sue to block California's under-16 'addictive feed' law (AB 1709)
industry.summary: Google, Meta and TikTok filed federal suits to block AB 1709, which bars under-16 personalized feeds/autoplay starting Jan 1, 2027 (with a July 2027 deadline to extend age-checks to existing devices), arguing First Amendment and parental-rights violations. This is the sharpest near-term US regulatory flashpoint on addictive teen feed design, directly validating NOMO's 'reward for time off addictive feeds' pitch as it pushes its US go-to-market.

industry.headline: UK government weighs extending under-16 social media ban to Vinted and eBay
industry.summary: Culture Secretary Lisa Nandy said the UK is 'looking seriously' at folding marketplace apps Vinted and eBay into the under-16 social media ban over grooming concerns tied to messaging features; the core ban (Instagram, TikTok, X, Snapchat, etc.) still takes effect March 2027. Directly touches NOMO's UK pilot market and CEO Leonardo's policy-advocacy role, signaling regulators will broaden scope quickly.

industry.headline: State AGs use Meta's $17.1B settlement and TikTok litigation to force durable product change
industry.summary: Analysis argues state attorneys general are increasingly using settlements and litigation (Meta's reported $17.1B deal, ongoing TikTok suits) to mandate durable product and policy changes rather than just extract fines — a trend that could create regulatory tailwinds for reward-based, off-platform engagement tools like NOMO.

industry.headline: California appeals court dismisses school districts' negligence claims against Meta, TikTok, Snap, YouTube
industry.summary: A California appeals court affirmed dismissal of negligence/nuisance claims brought by school districts across four states over alleged youth mental-health harms from social platforms. As litigation avenues close, schools are more likely to turn to proactive interventions — reinforcing NOMO's pitch as a practical alternative to the courts.

industry.headline: Ofcom ramps up child-safety enforcement pressure ahead of UK's under-16 ban
industry.summary: Ofcom reiterated that child protection is non-negotiable and warned of enforcement action against platforms that don't step up, following Snapchat's anti-grooming rollout, ahead of the UK's under-16 social media ban taking effect spring 2027. Sustains a receptive UK policy backdrop for NOMO's pilot and CEO engagement.

industry.headline: Australia's High Court hears Reddit-led constitutional challenge to under-16 social media ban
industry.summary: Reddit and the Digital Freedom Project argued the ban infringes political communication rights, while the government defended it on mental-health grounds, noting five million accounts closed since the ban began. A bellwether case for whether age-based bans survive legal challenge, relevant to AU (an exploratory NOMO market) and feeding into UK/US policy debates.
